session_note: Colorado's 2026 regular session (Second Regular Session of the 75th General Assembly) convened 2026-01-14 and adjourned sine die on 2026-05-13 (verified on leg.colorado.gov, which states legislation without a safety clause takes effect 2026-08-12, 90 days after sine die). Any bill not passed by both chambers and signed by the Governor by 2026-05-13 is dead for the year; Colorado does not carry individual bills forward into the next year's session -- a bill would need to be reintroduced under a new number in 2027.
